description: This source file implements GPU memory management and data transfer functions for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) on Apple hardware, specifically within the PyTorch Inductor framework. It includes functions for memory allocation, deallocation, copying, and device memory operations utilizing Metal API.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_malloc
methods.description: Allocates Metal device buffer memory of specified size using MPS device.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_free
methods.description: Releases the Metal buffer memory previously allocated.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_memcpy
methods.description: Copies data into a Metal buffer from a source pointer with specified offset and size.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_copy_buffer
methods.description: Copies data between two Metal buffers, utilizing Metal stream for synchronization and profiling.
